name: shell-fixture-aliases
goal: Resolve component fixture aliases correctly through both public and canonical build config entries

evidence: Component gallery builds fail because relocated shell config retains URL aliases relative to its previous folder. Every alias must identify its actual source owner.
Existing cold config tests omit shell Vite aliases. Extend that standard matrix to evaluate both public and canonical entries in fresh Bun runtimes and assert all five real targets.
Sealed red b8a7675b at d2077b68d fails the exact source owner assertion for both cold config entrypoints.
773af8472 fixes the five URL aliases relative to the canonical folder while preserving the public entry.
Sealed green f54fbbe8 passes both unchanged cold alias cases at 773af8472; all seven normal config cases pass too.
